This page documents my use of generative AI for

## Tool Information

| Item | Details |
|---|---|
| **Tool** | Claude (Anthropic), used in the Claude app, linked to my course folder and my website folder |
| **Date** | November 4–6, 2026 |
| **My files** | `PLAN.md`, `assignment8-dashboard.qmd`, `assignment8.scss`, `assignment8.qmd`, `data/hpi_panel.csv` |

## What Claude Did

- Read the assignment PDF and organized the work for Classes 7–9 and Assignment 8.
- Drafted `PLAN.md` from our team's project proposal slides.
- Checked whether our team's TEA data were available; they were not ready, so we chose the
  HPI data for the dashboard prototype.
- Computed the summary numbers used in the chart titles (for example, 69 of 74 countries
  rose; r = 0.47) so that each title matches the data.
- Wrote the dashboard code and the theme file, reusing my `eric_theme.R` style from Assignment 6.
- Drafted the English text of the assignment page.

## Prompts

The conversation was in Traditional Chinese. These are the prompts that shaped the
assignment, with English translations.

1. > 可以帶著我做assignment8嗎
   >
   > *(Can you guide me through Assignment 8?)*

2. > 但有個疑問為什麼plan.md不改呢
   >
   > *(But I have a question: why isn't PLAN.md changed?)*

3. > 好的那就先用HPI完成吧 不過我覺得先做的話會能夠幫助到他們 在完成HPI之後再完成TEA的
   >
   > *(OK, let's finish it with HPI first. But I think doing it early could help my teammates:
   > after finishing the HPI version, I will do the TEA one.)*

## My Decisions

- I chose to keep `PLAN.md` about our team's TEA project, because Part A asks for the plan of the
  final team project, and to add a note explaining why the prototype uses HPI.
- I chose the HPI data for the dashboard so that I could finish on time, and I plan to rebuild it
  with TEA data once the team has cleaned the files.
